title: Scenario-Based Risk Certificates for Multi-Property Vulnerability Discovery in Parametric MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20861v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety-critical systems such as network protocols and distributed algorithms depend on environmental parameters whose exact values are uncertain. Parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs) model such systems by making transition probabilities symbolic functions of the parameters. For a single quantitative requirement, parametric verification asks which parameter valuations satisfy the requirement. In practice, however, engineers often monitor several safety and performance requirements at once, and one valuation may make several requirements vulnerable simultaneously. In this paper we study multi-property vulnerability discovery under requirement-wise semantics: given a pMDP and M quantitative requirements, we construct candidate regions of the parameter space that may contain violations, and study budgets for random testing under a specified parameter distribution. translated_abstract: 诸如网络协议和分布式算法等安全关键系统依赖于精确值不确定的环境参数。参数化马尔可夫决策过程（pMDP）通过将转移概率表示为参数的符号函数来对这类系统进行建模。对于单个定量需求而言，参数化验证要回答的是哪些参数取值能够满足该需求。然而在实际应用中，工程师往往需要同时监测多个安全性与性能需求，且某一个参数取值可能同时使多个需求变得脆弱。本文研究了逐需求语义下的多属性脆弱性发现问题：给定一个 pMDP 和 M 个定量需求，我们构造参数空间中可能包含违例的候选区域，并研究在指定参数分布下进行随机测试所需的预算。为解决该问题，我们采用一种双层方法，其中场景……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种双层场景方法以生成风险证书，用于在参数化马尔可夫决策过程中同时发现可能违反多个定量需求的脆弱参数区域，并研究了指定参数分布下随机测试的预算问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-layered scenario-based approach to generate risk certificates for discovering parameter regions that may simultaneously violate multiple quantitative requirements in parametric MDPs, studying random testing budgets under a specified parameter distribution.
